summary: Global Tech Industries Group, Inc. (GTII) filed an 8-K on 2026-07-17 regarding the Receivership ordered by the Nevada court on 2024-09-18. The Receiver, Paul L. Strickland, submitted a Comprehensive Status Report consolidating investigations, cash/stock assets marshaled, settlements, and a going-forward plan to preserve value for public shareholders. No transaction price or premium involved. The plan includes pending transaction workstreams and return to SEC reporting compliance. Watch the court proceedings and any potential settlement or sale for restructuring outcomes.
